interview.hardest_part: Scaling from the initial bed/toilet setup through sustained oxygen, food, and power production into advanced research and six technologies.
interview.likely_failure: Losing track of the complex build/research UI and duplicant priorities, or letting resource consumption and stress outpace construction and research before advanced research is reached.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Native pause gives thinking time, speed controls accelerate waiting, queued build orders and autonomous duplicants reduce micromanagement, and tooltips help identify buildings and resources.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Real-time survival pressure, dependency chains for power/oxygen/food, advanced research requiring skills and infrastructure, and the one-action-per-step budget make long-horizon planning error-prone.
